name: x11-protocol-visualizer
description: X11 MITM proxy with live protocol visualization — inspect, link and throttle X11 traffic

comments.node-x11: The core decoder deliberately embeds its own span-aware reader with tables derived from node-x11's opcode values (see docs/decoder-and-state.md §2.1), so node-x11 is not a direct runtime dep. The npm package node-x11@1.0.4 also fails its native node-gyp build on Node 26; the current pure-JS node-x11 arrives transitively via react-x11 for the UI.
comments.@react-x11/components: Both UI packages are now published to npm (react-x11@2.0.0, @react-x11/components@0.2.0) with aligned versions: components declares peer react-x11@^2.0.0, which the semver range resolves. @lezer/highlight is an optional peer the <Code> component uses for syntax highlighting; react-x11's remaining peers (@babel/core, react-refresh, hot-module-replacement) are optional and only needed for its dev-time HMR path.
comments.ui-optional: The react-x11 UI stack is in optionalDependencies: the proxy/decoder core installs and runs without it, and the CLI falls back to a headless console renderer (--record / --no-ui) when the UI can't load.
